scope: RAW SAMPLE PLAN — six cases only; selection is not a dataset-wide sample
selection_rule: Reconciled after independent proposals by Subagents A and F and the main agent; metadata labels are provenance/evaluation only and never model inputs.

cases.reason: Metric-only resource-labeled case with a metadata injection/window contradiction; selected solely to adjudicate raw-data quality.
cases.uncertainty_tested: Whether inject_time.txt and metrics timestamps confirm, contradict, or leave unresolved the invalid metadata window.

cases.reason: Tri-modal network-labeled case; one side of cross-system trace-schema comparison.
cases.uncertainty_tested: Actual trace/log/metric schemas, cross-modal join keys, and directly observed service/call evidence.

cases.reason: Logs-plus-metrics case without declared traces; contrasts a network-labeled fault with the Online Boutique trace-bearing case.
cases.uncertainty_tested: Whether trace absence is real in raw layout and how graph construction must classify the missing modality.

cases.reason: The only metadata-declared RE2-TT case with traces but no logs.
cases.uncertainty_tested: Raw absence versus an empty/malformed logs file; trace schema at a second trace-bearing system.

cases.reason: Code-level case with metadata-declared root_cause.txt and no traces.
cases.uncertainty_tested: Exact leakage content and safe exclusion of root_cause.txt from log/model enumeration.

cases.reason: Tri-modal code-level case with a distinct root target and cross-system schema coverage.
cases.uncertainty_tested: Whether raw telemetry supports operation/resource identity and how service-level ground truth maps to observed entities.
